Name: Lumisteria More Pickled Products
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds several recipes for the preserve jars and items that you can obtain from them. The produces usually take the same amount of time to be ready than pickles and jellies.

[b]1.0.1[/b] : now include german translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2796938]Jely[/url].


The produces :

Pickled eggs :
All items of category "eggs" will give their own pickled products. They will take longer to process than mayonnaise, meaning that they aren't always a better option, depending of your goal and the space you have. There is a small chance to obtain more products if the eggs are of quality. A protein lover would likely love some pickled eggs !
Eggs added by mod should be supported if they are in the egg category.

Pickled forage goods :
Not all forage good are able to be pickled, only the ones that should be considered "edible". As the eggs, they can give more products if they are of quality.
The gift taste for them are usually the same than pickles, with some exception : Georges loves pickled leeks for example.

Pickled edible flowers :
Fairy Rose, Dandelion and Poppy are able to be made in their respective jellies. As for the other, they can give more products if they are of quality.
Modded flowers that would have the custom context tag "edible_flower_item" will also give specific products.
Some of the jellies have specific gift tastes : Evelyn loves flower jellies, and Sandy loves Fairy Rose flower jelly.

Note : when i made this mod i wasn't aware of the existence of[url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10227321] PFM Flower Jelly [/url]made by [url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/]Kaya[/url], and i learned about it just some days ago. Fortunately, you can use both ! Since my mod works only on specific flowers, PFM flower jelly is a good option if you want to make jelly with every flower possible ! the way PFM works means that my products should have higher priority, so if you use both, you will get the generic flower jelly product for all flowers i don't touch and the specific ones for the ones i change.
[url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/]
Kaya[/url] makes lovely mods and i encourage you to look at them !
